newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Adcorp says acquires Grey Appointments.
newsitem.headline: Adcorp says acquires Grey Appointments.

text.p: Services group Adcorp Holdings said on Sunday it had acquired personnel placement firm Grey Appointments.
A company statement said the acquisition would be settled by a half-half mixture of cash and Adcorp shares, but did not give details.
It also did not give the purchase price of Grey, a staff recruitment company specialising in placement of senior financial staff.
The Adcorp group is currently involved in communications, human resources and market research.
"Adcorp is especially pleased to have gained entry into the area of the human resource market where we have not been involved before," chairman John Barry said in the statement.
"It is a high-demand market because of the acute shortage of quality financial people."
The purchase was with effect from January 1, 1997.
